```python
def transform(grid):
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0])
    # Initialize the output grid with the background color 8
    output_grid = [[8 for _ in range(cols)] for _ in range(rows)]
    
    for c in range(cols):
        # Collect all non-background items from the current column
        items = []
        for r in range(rows):
            if grid[r][c] != 8:
                items.append(grid[r][c])
        
        # Place the items at the bottom of the column, preserving their order
        num_items = len(items)
        start_row = rows - num_items
        for i, val in enumerate(items):
            output_grid[start_row + i][c] = val
            
    return output_grid
```
